name: Ivana Kovačić
bio:
Ivana Kovačić's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the newsroom. A seasoned journalist with a keen eye for compelling narratives, she covered local racing events before transitioning to Formula 3, quickly recognizing the captivating stories beyond the checkered flag. Her unique approach blends traditional PR with a journalist's instinct for uncovering the most engaging aspects of a team and its drivers. 

At Signature Racing, Ivana is renowned for her ability to build strong relationships with the media and craft innovative campaigns that resonate with fans. She believes in transparency and authenticity, often providing unprecedented access to behind-the-scenes moments. Her knack for anticipating public perception and proactively addressing potential crises has made her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring Signature Racing maintains a positive image even amidst the high-pressure environment of competitive racing.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail
physical.description: Ivana has a warm, approachable demeanor and a sharp, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, scribbling down ideas at any moment.
Insists on starting every press release with a compelling hook, often a human-interest angle.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming, deep in thought.
